title: ターン制タクティクス：M01〜M30副目標全90条件（正式採用）

precedence.priority: All 90 conditions here are the latest user-adopted design; for M01-M07 this overrides the conditions in PR #116 and currently implemented PR #117 wherever they differ.
precedence.midgameM19Change: Previous 70% transport HP proposal NOT ADOPTED; adopted condition is one controlled kill in R6 reinforcement.
precedence.other: M08-M14, M15-M21, M22-M30 reflect subsequent explicitly accepted proposals.
precedence.olderRecords: Historical JSON/PR docs remain for traceability, not alternate authorities. No change to other game mechanics or reward table.

sharedRules.victoryRequired: A condition can be latched earlier, but grants subobjective success only on main mission victory.
sharedRules.difficultyPolicy: Easy is generally composition/easier action; Normal and Hard have identical subobjective predicates despite different enemy balance.
sharedRules.timing: All sortie gear/frame checks use the three directly controlled robots' equipped loadout at sortie-start; owned but not equipped is insufficient; never reevaluate after midcombat loadout differences.

weaponFamilies.notes: Where a condition names the first weapon only, check weapon1 exclusively.

sharedRules.frameGroups: Use frame group ID (e.g. mobile), not an individual variant, unless the condition explicitly says otherwise.
sharedRules.controlled: 自機 = the three directly controlled robots; friendly AI contributes only where a condition explicitly permits allied control or an allied formation.
sharedRules.damage: HPダメージ means strictly positive actual target HP reduction after defense/limits; avoid recording zero-damage contacts or overkill beyond actual current HP.
sharedRules.roundEnd: Round-end ownership and proximity are evaluated at a completed round-end using the final authoritative stage state after prescribed transport progress and capture evaluation; do not infer from previews.
sharedRules.space: 周囲8マス = Chebyshev distance exactly 1 around occupied target cell(s), not radius beyond 1. Facility multi-cell occupancy uses union around any footprint cell.
sharedRules.first: 最初/以前/後 means ordered committed in-battle event records. Never award based on action intent, canceled actions, or speculative history.
sharedRules.history: Missions requiring cross-round damage/kill/protection/breakthrough/collection history must retain it across resume/reload and reject duplicate actions, and must reset it on a new sortie/retry. If old saved combat has no trustworthy history, do not guess and award.
sharedRules.rewards: Do not alter missions.json firstSubobjective EXP/addonId or first-clear/replay rewards; retain first-time grant and idempotency.
sharedRules.noteOnImplementation: This document is authoritative design data only, not proof that stage M08-M30 runtime or changed M01-M07 runtime is implemented.

revised.adopted: one successful breakthrough unit damages an enemy before its own crossing
both depots direct-controlled positive HP damage and at least one depot direct-controlled final kill
controlled guard adjacent to convoy at completed end of at least one round R4+
at victory own one of the winning two-plus bases with a directly controlled unit

approvedStrategy.minimizeRoundReduction: M02 Normal/Hard is the only round-shortening subobjective in the approved set.
approvedStrategy.protectAgainstNpcTargeting: Avoid stringent convoy HP percentage in late stages; M05 normal/hard guard action replaces former HP60, M19 R6 reinforcement kill replaces proposed HP70. M05 Easy and M12 Normal/Hard keep approved HP values.
approvedStrategy.lateStageExtraBurden: M22-M30 already require multiple victory objectives. Additional requirements should be small, actionable, and not demand rushed round count, strong additional damage output, or high convoy remaining HP.
approvedStrategy.measureLater: Confirm attainability in actual AI playtests; changing values requires fresh design approval.
